references.text: Moses gave the original command to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh to help their brothers take possession of the land west of the Jordan before they could return to their own land.
The original agreement between Moses and the tribes east of the Jordan, in which they promised to fight alongside the other tribes until the land was taken.
Moses gave the land east of the Jordan to Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh as their inheritance.
The fulfillment of this promise when Joshua sent Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh back to their inherited land east of the Jordan after the conquest was completed.
The promise of rest in the land that the Lord gives, linked to obedience to God's commands.
The preceding context in which Joshua reminds the tribes east of the Jordan of Moses' command and their promise to help their brothers.
The description of the land distribution east of the Jordan that Moses gave to the two and a half tribes.
